fast_track_glass.covers: Glass-only claims: windshield chip, crack, side or rear glass, comprehensive glass coverage, no other damage and no injuries.
fast_track_glass.not_for: Collision damage, frame damage, injury, total loss, fraud indicators, or a claim that also mentions body damage.
examples: Rock chip on the windshield on Highway 407
Rear window cracked by a falling branch
Side mirror glass broken overnight

assign_auto_collision.covers: Collision or upset involving a vehicle: rear-end, parking lot, hit-and-run, animal strike, DCPD, no-fault, with photos and a police or joint report where available.
assign_auto_collision.not_for: Glass-only claims, injury claims, total loss, fraud indicators, or missing basic facts.
examples: Ontario DCPD rear-end on the 401
Parking lot collision in Toronto
Hit-and-run in Vancouver with a police report

assign_property_water.covers: Water damage to a home or condo: burst pipe, sewer backup, appliance leak, ceiling leak, flood damage to contents and structure.
assign_property_water.not_for: Auto water damage, fire damage, liability claims, or a CAT event affecting an entire neighbourhood.
examples: Burst pipe flooded the basement
Sewer backup after heavy rain
Condo pipe leak through the ceiling

assign_property_fire.covers: Fire, smoke, soot, or firefighting water damage to a home or commercial property.
assign_property_fire.not_for: Water-only losses, auto fires, wildfire CAT events affecting many homes, or liability claims.
examples: Kitchen fire with smoke damage
Electrical fire in the garage
Wildfire embers damaged the roof and deck

assign_liability.covers: Third-party bodily injury or property damage liability: slip and fall, customer injury, damage caused by the insured or an employee.
assign_liability.not_for: First-party auto or property damage, glass claims, or claims with no third-party allegation.
examples: Customer slipped on a wet floor at a grocery store
Delivery driver damaged a customer's fence
Slip and fall on an icy sidewalk

assign_injury.covers: Any claim with a reported injury: whiplash, neck or back pain, ambulance attendance, physiotherapy, medical reports, or a pedestrian injury.
assign_injury.not_for: Property-only or glass-only claims, or claims where the only injury is a pre-existing condition unrelated to the loss.
examples: Rear-ended with neck and back pain
Passenger with whiplash and headaches
Pedestrian struck in a crosswalk

assign_total_loss.covers: Vehicle write-off or total loss, including fire, flood, hail, or collision where repair is not economical; includes lienholder and buyout review.
assign_total_loss.not_for: Repairable collision damage, glass-only claims, or a vehicle that has not been declared a total loss.
examples: Vehicle declared a total loss with a lienholder
Older SUV written off after hail damage
Fire destroyed the vehicle in the driveway

refer_siu.covers: Special investigation indicators: staged accident, inconsistent stories, no vehicle damage with injury claims, same clinic or passengers across claims, duplicate claims, inflated estimates, or a relationship with the repair shop.
refer_siu.not_for: Ordinary collisions, glass claims, weather events, or a single suspicious detail without corroborating indicators.
examples: Three passengers, same clinic, no bumper damage
Staged accident with sudden braking
Same stolen watch reported under two policies

request_more_info.covers: The note is missing facts needed to route or decide: no photos, no police report, no receipts, no proof of ownership, or an unclear description of the loss.
request_more_info.not_for: Claims with enough facts to route, or cases where the missing information is not required for the next step.
examples: No photos and no police report
Water damage with no receipts
Lost jewellery with no proof of ownership

escalate_complaint.covers: Complaints and regulatory or legal escalation: FSRA, AMF, BCFSA, Ombudsman, lawyer, MPP, supervisor request, or repeated unresolved service complaint.
escalate_complaint.not_for: A normal claim update call or a request for information that is not a complaint.
examples: Customer will contact FSRA and their MPP
Policyholder mentions the Ombudsman and a lawyer
Complaint about adjuster conduct

triage_health_dental.covers: Health and dental benefit claims: dental crown or predetermination, paramedical services, physiotherapy, vision care, prescription glasses.
triage_health_dental.not_for: Auto injury claims, property damage, liability, or a complaint about a health claim decision.
examples: Dental crown predetermination in Manitoba
Paramedical physiotherapy receipts
Vision care claim for prescription glasses

assign_catastrophe_team.covers: Catastrophe or mass event: hail, wildfire, flood, freezing rain, or a event affecting many homes or a whole neighbourhood.
assign_catastrophe_team.not_for: A single isolated property loss with no signs of a wider event.
examples: Hail storm in Calgary with many neighbours affected
Wildfire evacuation in BC
Freezing rain across the region
